entities.name: BANCR
observations: BANCR overexpression in human bladder-cancer T24 and SW780 cells reduced proliferation and migration and increased apoptosis (PMID:27514530).

entities.name: Human bladder cancer
observations: The primary BANCR gain-of-function study evaluated bladder-cancer tissues and T24 and SW780 cell lines (PMID:27514530).

entities.name: PMID:27514530
observations: He et al. reported that pcDNA-BANCR overexpression inhibited proliferation, induced apoptosis, and suppressed migration in T24 and SW780 bladder-cancer cells; BANCR was also lower in tumor tissues than adjacent noncancerous tissues.

entities.name: BANCR suppresses bladder cancer phenotypes
observations: In vitro pcDNA-BANCR overexpression in T24 and SW780 human bladder-cancer cells inhibited proliferation and migration and induced apoptosis; clinical therapeutic benefit was not tested (PMID:27514530).
